technical.summary: Oversold conditions present but severely undermined by bearish structure, negative momentum, and lack of bullish confirmation—high-probability short setup rather than swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 21 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling signal from non-senior member with small amounts; market fear (36 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (384.8), flat yield curve, and earnings in 21 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for AOS trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Stochastic and Williams %R oversold with Supertrend bullish signal and fear-zone VIX present contrarian bounce opportunity near support at 59.48.
debate.key_bear_argument: All RSI variants bearish, price below all moving averages, MACD negative, Ichimoku below cloud, three black crows pattern, zero momentum confirmation, high earnings risk in 21 days, and crisis macro backdrop (VIX 384.8) create a high-probability short setup rather than swing long entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Oversold technicals (stoch, Williams %R) and fear-zone VIX present contrarian bounce setup. However, bearish structure dominates: all RSI variants negative, price below all MAs, MACD negative, Ichimoku below cloud, three black crows pattern, and zero momentum confirmation.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings in 21 days combined with crisis macro (VIX 384.8) and complete absence of bullish momentum confirmation create high probability of continued downside rather than bounce.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias; debate winner decisively bear (9 vs 3)
decision.portfolio_note: Already 12 positions in Industrials sector; adding AOS increases concentration risk without fundamental or smart money support.
